_schema.note: Working use cases discovered by composing Claude + connector capabilities across scales. Only coherent combos are listed.

usecases.name: Inbox-to-Action Desk
usecases.why_short: Claude reads what comes in via Gmail and turns it into tracked work in Todoist.

usecases.name: Meeting Follow-through
usecases.why_short: Claude turns Fireflies into follow-ups and records in Todoist.

usecases.name: Research Desk
usecases.why_short: Claude gathers evidence from Exa and writes a durable brief in Notion.

usecases.name: Data-to-Dashboard
usecases.why_short: Claude queries Snowflake and builds the dashboard in Tableau.

usecases.name: Outbound Sales Desk
usecases.why_short: Claude sources and enriches leads via ZoomInfo and runs outbound through HubSpot.

usecases.name: Pipeline Cockpit
usecases.why_short: Claude keeps the pipeline in HubSpot moving through Klaviyo.

usecases.name: Ship-it Dev Loop
usecases.why_short: Claude reads the repo in Sourcegraph and ships it via Replit.

usecases.name: Incident War-room
usecases.why_short: Claude watches Datadog and drives the response through Slack.

usecases.name: Finance Back Office
usecases.why_short: Claude reconciles money movement in Stripe and reports it through Notion.

usecases.name: Storefront Ops
usecases.why_short: Claude runs the store in Shop end to end with Stripe.

usecases.name: Content Studio
usecases.why_short: Claude produces creative in Canva and ships it through Bitly.

usecases.name: Support Desk
usecases.why_short: Claude resolves tickets in Intercom with context from HubSpot.

usecases.name: Recruiting Pipeline
usecases.why_short: Claude sources and screens in Ashby and moves candidates through Gmail.

usecases.name: Legal Ops
usecases.why_short: Claude researches and drafts from Harvey and routes for signature via Docusign.

usecases.name: Trading Desk
usecases.why_short: Claude researches markets in FMP and manages the book in Interactive Brokers (IBKR).

usecases.name: Daily Brief
usecases.why_short: Claude assembles a brief from Gmail into Notion.

usecases.name: Knowledge Hub
usecases.why_short: Claude keeps a living knowledge base in Google Drive, refreshed from Exa.

usecases.name: Support Desk
usecases.why_short: Claude runs a whole Support operation — Email, Chat / messaging, Notes & docs, Support desk, Tasks & projects — coordinating across all of it from the centre.

usecases.name: Sales Desk
usecases.why_short: Claude runs a whole Sales operation — CRM, Lead discovery, Email, Company enrichment, Chat / messaging, Notes & docs, Tasks & projects — coordinating across all of it from the centre.
